ambient_events: An instrument goes into the boil and comes out and is laid on clean linen.
Somebody in the queue is moved up it, and nobody objects.
A splint is cut down to fit a limb that has an extra joint in it.
description: A whitewashed building with a covered porch, a boot scraper, and a bell. The busiest door in the Thornwarren after the bathhouse. There is a queue and it is not first-come, and everybody in it knows the order and nobody argues about it.
name: The Physic
